Six YC startups from the 2022 and 2023 batches are based in France and currently list job openings. I used the YC Startup Directory with these filters: batches Winter 2022, Summer 2022, Winter 2023 and Summer 2023; HQ region France; Is Hiring.

| Company | Batch | What they do | Location |
|---|---|---|---|
| Osium AI | Summer 2023 | AI to speed up materials innovation | Paris |
| Rimward | Summer 2023 | Solar farm security software for existing cameras | Paris |
| Twenty | Summer 2023 | Open-source CRM | Paris |
| HyLight | Summer 2023 | Unmanned airships for inspecting critical assets | Paris |
| Escape | Winter 2023 | Offensive security tooling | Paris |
| Windmill | Summer 2022 | Open-source platform to turn scripts into internal apps and workflows | Paris |

- **Missing French founders:** The directory's own note says the HQ filter doesn't include companies originally founded in France or by founders from there. A French-founded company headquartered elsewhere, such as San Francisco, won't appear.
- **Hiring flag not checked:** I relied on YC's "Is Hiring" flag. I didn't open each company's job page to confirm the individual openings.
